grades.overall_note: The agent got the payment arrangement right: the landlord pays his contractor direct and nothing goes through the agency. It sensibly asked the contractor to confirm every item before anything was closed. It fell short by setting no hold or review date, missing the conflicting system records in events 034 and 035, and not weighing the active pigeon nest.
